items.headline: Mississippi coach Pete Golding aims to eradicate erratic play in Week 2 against Charlotte
items.description: — After erratic play nearly cost No. 9 Mississippi in its season opener, coach Pete Golding has made consistency an over-arching theme while preparing for Saturday's home opener against Charlotte.

items.headline: Gavin Garcia rushes for 3 TDs to lead The Citadel past Charlotte 43-41 in 3OT
items.description: — Gavin Garcia rushed for 137 yards and three touchdowns as The Citadel beat Charlotte 43-41 in triple overtime on Saturday in the 49ers’ season opener, following a 1-hour and 15-minute delay due to severe weather.
